{{Quote|Dead? What did you think? The rakghouls would buy them flowers and send them home?|Garthe|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Garthe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Old Republic era]]. During this period on Taris, he worked on a Republic archaeological salvage team known as the Corpse Counters on Taris during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Most of his team was lost when rakghouls cut them off, and only Garthe and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cera (Human)|Cera]] survived. When Cera asked a traveling hero to find their team and see if anyone else was still alive, the hero found a recording of a dying member of the team, and it was revealed that Garthe and the dying member had stolen goods off of the bodies they were supposed to be collecting.

==Behind the scenes==
Garthe appears for the first time in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' published by [[BioWare]]. He appears in the mission ''The Corpse Counters'' for Republic players only.
